title: Declined Work shows in its own section with names and descriptions only
preconditions:
1. You are signed in to ShopView.
2. A document exists whose work order has declined work lines (with names, descriptions, and internal scope-of-work notes), and the "Show declined work" option is enabled.
3. To open the document on screen: click "Work Orders" in the top menu, open the work order (click its row), then click the "Finance" tab. The document appears on the right.
4. Use the "Estimate / Invoice" toggle above the document to switch between the Estimate and the Invoice.
5. NOTE (build reality): the cog display-settings dialog has no "Show declined work" control on the observed build, and the rendered document shows no Declined Work section. There is no UI control to switch declined work on for the document, so this state cannot be reached from the screen. Do not use an API call to force it. If the control is added to the build, confirm the route and re-test; until then this case is NOT AVAILABLE ON BUILD.
steps:
1. Click "Work Orders" in the top menu, open the work order, click the "Finance" tab, and show the Estimate or Invoice.
2. On the observed build there is no control to switch declined work onto the document, so the Declined Work section cannot be produced from the screen. Record this as NOT AVAILABLE ON BUILD; do not force the state with an API call.
3. Find the Declined Work section and read its lines.
expected:
1. Declined work appears in its own section headed exactly "Declined Work", separate from the main work section.
2. Each declined line shows its name, and its description when a description is present.
3. A declined line never shows a scope-of-work note (the technician's internal write-up) - that note does not print for declined work on any customer document.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8218 and story SV-9145 (Story 6, Declined Work) and the Invoice UI Refresh specification version 45, sections S6-R1 and S6-R2, read on 31 August 2026.

steps:
